summary: Completed comprehensive testing of DataViz module integration. Frontend components and routes are properly integrated, but backend APIs have significant implementation gaps. Dashboard creation works via POST, but most GET endpoints are missing or misconfigured.

critical_bugs.impact: Charts page cannot load or display existing charts
Dashboards page cannot list existing dashboards
Charts and dashboards cannot access data sources
Dashboard builder cannot create or manage widgets

working_endpoints: Analysis chart endpoints exist (POST-based for heatmap, violin, coefficient plots)

integration_issues.issue: Users redirected back to login when accessing /charts, /dashboards, /report-builder
integration_issues.details: Authentication works but users cannot access DataViz pages - possible organization setup or authorization issue

working_features: ✅ All DataViz React components properly imported and exist
✅ Login authentication working with demo credentials
✅ DashboardLayout navigation structure includes DataViz menu items
✅ UI components use proper data-testid attributes for testing

action_item_for_main_agent: CRITICAL: Implement missing DataViz backend APIs - GET endpoints for /api/charts, /api/dashboards, /api/datasets, and /api/widgets are either missing or misconfigured (returning 404/405 errors). Also investigate authentication/organization setup issues preventing frontend access to DataViz pages despite successful login.

success_percentage.backend: 30% (3/10 endpoints functional - dashboard creation works, but listing/reading APIs missing)
success_percentage.frontend: 70% (routes and components integrated, but blocked by backend/auth issues)
success_percentage.overall: 50% (UI integration complete, but backend APIs need implementation)
